grandpa-demon-disable.name: Disable Grandpa Demon
grandpa-demon-disable.description: Replaces Grandpa Demon at rank 1 with Silent Demon, including it in the Silent search.

infinite-demon-disable.name: Disable BG Effects
infinite-demon-disable.description: Removes animated backgrounds from Legendary, Mythical, Silent, and Grandpa Demon level pages.

particles-disable.name: Disable Particles
particles-disable.description: Removes particles from Legendary, Mythical, Silent, and Grandpa Demon level pages.
